verdict.rationale: Mollie documents multicurrency acceptance through its v2 APIs, so international customers can pay in their preferred currency beyond EUR. Settlement reports break down the transactions, fees and deductions in each payout, but nothing in the evidence describes converting those funds into the merchant's own settlement currency or disclosing FX rates and markups. Missing for 10: documented settlement-currency conversion to the merchant's bank currency, transparent FX rate/markup disclosure, FX line items in settlement reporting, independent corroboration.
